notes.title: 1.0 OpenXR Update
notes.content:
With OpenXR The Imaginarium should be compatible with most VR headsets.
Also a bunch of bugs and optimization issues have been resolved.
It has only been tested on Oculus, if you have any problems please write them in the comments or email me at Eternalechoesvr@gmail.com.
